Class ClusterCoordinator

java.lang.Object
io.github.dzdcache.cluster.ClusterCoordinator
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class ClusterCoordinator extends Object implements AutoCloseable
One master orders every change in a replicated log; members apply committed entries in log order.
